answer: That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that pays. The plume counter is kept in lagoon and thread shows each threshold crossing. An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 8 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. Repeating the trick 52 times costs 34 separate deposits and 16 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
